sources.notes: Bit semantics cross-checked 2026-11-28: Wikipedia OBD-II_PIDs (4 bytes big-endian, MSB = next PID +1 ... LSB = +32; worked example BE1FA813 decodes to PIDs 01,03,04,05,06,07,0C,0D,0E,0F,10,11,13,15,1C,1F,20), csselectronics.com PID table (PID 00 'PIDs supported [01 - 20]', 32 bits, encoded), slideshare SAE J1979 deck, github digitalbond/canbus-utils PID list. The formula column holds the raw 32-bit value; use decode_supported_pids() for the PID list. Verify against purchased SAE J1979 before production.
